title: Stock Indicator Strategy
instructions: Refactor indicator calculation into the Strategy pattern. In `stock/strategies.py` declare the abstract `TradingIndicatorStrategy.calculate_indicator` and implement moving average, momentum and volatility. In `stock/manager.py` make `StockTradingManager` take a strategy object and delegate to it instead of branching on the enum.

evidence.label: TradingIndicatorStrategy is an ABC declaring calculate_indicator
Each indicator is its own concrete strategy
Momentum is price - previous_close and keeps its sign
Strategies use only price and previous_close
StockTradingManager delegates once with the same stock
One manager serves every strategy, including new ones
